title: Phone call with Rep. Mike Gallagher and interview with House subcommittee staff

tellings.quote: after one phone call with uh representative Mike Gallagher Republican representative W of the of his district in Wyoming

plain: Eric Davis, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that in 2024 he had a phone call with Mike Gallagher, a Republican member of the US House of Representatives, and was then interviewed by staff of a House subcommittee looking into UFOs. Davis tells it as part of how he says Congress came to hear what he knows, which would matter if officials were really gathering inside accounts of hidden UFO knowledge.
